quickEarsPreview.scope: Static hosting with prepackaged lessons; local launcher also supports live lessons.
quickEarsPreview.liveTranscript: Static deployments load lesson-packs/available.json and one answer/audio-URL pack on selection. Localhost additionally supports the original Python preview.
quickEarsPreview.packageUpdate: Update-Dictation-Pack.cmd resumes validated packs and rebuilds the PWA. MP3s remain on the source host. Only the available index is precached.
quickEarsPreview.catalog: 813 lessons across six topics including 360 IELTS Listening parts
quickEarsPreview.feedback: Hints appear on submit only. Empty submission reveals the first word; otherwise show the correct prefix and reveal the first incorrect or missing word in bold, masking only subsequent words. Optional full-answer checkbox shows the entire original sentence on unsuccessful submission.
quickEarsPreview.translation: Optional Vietnamese translation requested only after correct submission
quickEarsPreview.scoring: Correct on submitted answer 1–3 / correct after three misses / skipped. Audio replay alone does not change the grade. Legacy history retains its original counts.
quickEarsPreview.resume: Local per-profile, per-lesson checkpoint in its original qe_run_ entry. Resume restores drafts, attempts, pending Next and 20-sentence summaries; legacy partial runs resume from aggregate answered count.
quickEarsPreview.checkpoints: Every 20 completed items; whole-lesson totals at finish
quickEarsPreview.navigation: Logo menu, lesson picker, exercise; standalone Ctrl replays audio
quickEarsPreview.controls: Equal picker actions (back left/start right), headphone pause sprite, volume and full-answer preferences, always visible progress and automatic Vietnamese translation after correct answers. Same settings dialog and action row from menu and exercise.
quickEarsPreview.interfaceLanguage: English; correct answers receive a Vietnamese translation.
quickEarsPreview.buttons: Four blank raster frames, separate unframed Arcade Hub glyphs; Pause uses the shared system-controls atlas.
quickEarsPreview.hubPlacement: Sixth tile, after Grammar Space and before Quiz. Each carousel card shows a title and short English description.
quickEarsPreview.audio: Shared entry, menu and exit cues. Active listening and its pause panel suppress UI sounds. Hub carousel switch plays at half the master volume.
quickEarsPreview.history: Per-run aggregate scores stored locally by profile, picker shows completed/in-progress/unstarted. No transcript or cloud writes.

grammarTopicLibrary: Overview first; toggle one topic to reveal its lessons. Shared profile, practice and apply progress retained; Hub back icon and exit-only audio.
grammarTopicOverviewSize: Full-width responsive overview with all topic buttons visible. Only the selected lesson list has internal scrolling.
effectsVolume: Effects gain = 0.20 times displayed slider level; switch cue retains its half trim. Pronunciation and listening media independent.
